nb_queried.name: NB-5 Property & Real Estate (curated, ledger ground-truth source)

nb_query: Can a foreigner or a foreign-owned PT PMA legally hold a Pondok Wisata license in Bali/Indonesia, or is it reserved for Indonesian citizens (WNI) as individual businesses? What is the compliant licensing route for a foreigner who wants to operate tourist villa accommodation?
ledger_current_fact_candidate: Pondok Wisata is reserved for Indonesian citizens (WNI) as individuals; a foreigner / PT PMA CANNOT hold it. Foreigner route = PT PMA + Villa KBLI in a Pink tourism zone via OSS-RBA. Nominee = criminal under Perda Bali 4/2026.
nb_citation_verbatim: Foreign nationals and foreign-owned companies (PT PMA) are strictly prohibited from holding a Pondok Wisata (homestay) license ... Permenpar No. 18/2016, Pasal 4(3): 'Perseorangan sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (2) merupakan warga negara Indonesia' ... Permenparekraf 9/2014 defines it as 'usaha perseorangan' (blocks corporate entities incl. PT PMA). The only compliant route is a PT PMA registered under the Villa KBLI in a Pink (Tourism) zone. Nominee = void + criminalized under Perda Bali No. 4/2026 (up to 5 yrs / IDR 1B).
verdict_rationale: Live NB-5 confirms the core ledger fact verbatim (WNI-only via Permenpar 18/2016 Pasal 4(3) + Permenparekraf 9/2014; foreigner route = PT PMA + Villa). NOTE a cross-NB code divergence: NB-5 (property) labels the Villa code '55193' (calls it current 'Investment Gold Standard'), whereas NB-3/BPS authoritatively recodes it 55193 -> 55203. This is the SEPARATE P1 claim KBLI-VILLA-55193-CURRENT (out of the 6 P0-NLM scope) and does NOT weaken the WNI-only verdict. Fix text uses the authoritative 55203.
